extractedText: Home Entertainment K-POP BTS' ”Dynamite” music video surpasses 2 billion views... a first for the group Comment BTS' ”Dynamite” music video surpasses 2 billion views... a first for the group BTS has become the first music video to reach 2 billion views. The digital single was released simultaneously worldwide on August 21, 2020 on HYBE's label YouTube channel. The music video for the group's song "Dynamite" surpassed 2 billion views on YouTube at around 9:16 a.m. on the 4th. This makes "Dynamite" the second most viewed song by BTS. It is the first music video to reach the 2 billion view mark, achieving another great feat. Since reaching 1.9 billion views in December last year, it has added 100 million views in about nine months. "Dynamite" is a bright and cheerful disco-pop song, and is the first English song that BTS has performed. The music video is highly addictive. The rhythm is combined with a fun and dynamic performance. The lively concept makes use of a bright atmosphere, and the performance is full of energy and fun, and the audience can enjoy the music with ease. "Dynamite" was recently named the most played song in the world in the past 10 years by global music streaming service Apple Music. This song, along with "Butter," is the only song by a K-pop group to make it onto the chart, further proving the influence of BTS. BTS achieved a historic feat with "Dynamite." With this song, they became the first Korean singer to top the main song chart of the US Billboard. It reached number one on the "MTV 100" and stayed at the top for three weeks. It also won the awards "Best Song" and "2021 Best Song" at the "2020 MTV Europe Music Awards." In addition to winning the "Top Selling Song" award at the Billboard Music Awards, the Recording Industry Association of Japan has awarded it a Streaming Diamond certification (5 It has achieved remarkable results, including being viewed over 100 million times.
